MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q:Project) WHERE p<>q
WITH p.projectKey AS pk, a.issueKey AS ak, b.issueKey AS bk, r.linkId AS l
UNWIND [[pk,ak],[null,bk]] AS x
RETURN count(*) AS n

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q:Project) WHERE p<>q
UNWIND [[p.projectKey,a.issueKey],[q.projectKey,b.issueKey]] AS x
WITH x[0] AS id, count(DISTINCT x[1]) AS value
ORDER BY value DESC RETURN id, value

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q:Project) WHERE p<>q
WITH collect({p:p.projectKey,a:a.issueKey,q:q.projectKey,b:b.issueKey,l:r.linkId}) AS rows
UNWIND rows AS x
WITH x WHERE x.p IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'] OR x.q IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM']
UNWIND [x.a,x.b] AS issue
RETURN DISTINCT issue, x.l AS link, x.p AS project

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q:Project) WHERE p<>q
UNWIND [[p.projectKey,a.issueKey],[q.projectKey,b.issueKey]] AS x
WITH x[0] AS id, count(DISTINCT x[1]) AS value
ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN id, value

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q:Project) WHERE p<>q AND (p.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'] OR q.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'])
UNWIND [a.issueKey,b.issueKey] AS issue
RETURN DISTINCT issue, r.linkId AS link
